CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Placental villi
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal testing of fetal tissue during current pregnancy. Previous pregnancy with de novo unbalanced translocation involving the long arms of chromosomes 2 and 6.

TEST PERFORMED
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) Analysis

METHODOLOGY
In situ hybridization was performed on spontaneous metaphases and interphase nuclei from uncultured placental villi. The following probes were utilized:
- GenProbe 2q (D2S447) - Chromosome 2q subtelomere region (2q37.3)
- CentraScan 6 (D6Z1) - Chromosome 6 centromere
- ChromoMap subtel 6q (D6S2522) - Chromosome 6q subtelomere region (6q27)

A minimum of 50 interphase nuclei and available metaphases were analyzed for each probe set.

RESULTS
ish 2q37.3(D2S447x2),6cen(D6Z1x2),6q27(D6S2522x2)

No abnormality detected. Results are consistent with a normal complement for chromosomes 2 and 6 in the regions tested.

Detailed findings:
- D2S447 (2q37.3): Two signals observed in all cells analyzed
- D6Z1 (6cen): Two signals observed in all cells analyzed
- D6S2522 (6q27): Two signals observed in all cells analyzed

INTERPRETATION
FISH analysis of uncultured placental villi shows normal signal patterns for the chromosome 2q subtelomere, chromosome 6 centromere, and chromosome 6q subtelomere regions. These findings indicate that the current pregnancy does not carry the unbalanced translocation involving chromosomes 2 and 6 that was identified in the previous pregnancy.

The normal FISH results for these specific regions provide reassurance regarding the chromosomal status of the current pregnancy with respect to the previously identified familial chromosomal rearrangement.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Additional chromosome analysis is pending and will be reported separately
2. PCR-based analyses are in progress to further evaluate the fetal genetic status
3. Continued genetic counseling is recommended to discuss these results and pending analyses
4. Results should be correlated with ultrasound findings and other prenatal screening tests

LIMITATIONS
This targeted FISH analysis evaluates only the specific chromosomal regions tested and does not exclude other chromosomal abnormalities. Complete karyotype analysis is pending.
